LanguageData.LP_ChainbreakerExile.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was once an orc slave soldier under Thay's Red Wizards, and the slave brand is still on [PAWN_possessive] forehead. [PAWN_pronoun] dug trenches, carried shields and died at the front for the expedition, until one night of rout [PAWN_pronoun] smashed the leg irons and fled into the wilds.

LanguageData.LP_CryptRecluse.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was once the most gifted necromancy apprentice at a frontier academy. [PAWN_possessive] master died of plague and [PAWN_possessive] fellow students were burned in the square by witch-hunting paladins; only [PAWN_nameDef] escaped, carrying the master's notes into an ancient crypt beneath the wastes. [PAWN_pronoun] spent many years there alone: practicing on the corpses of beasts and grave robbers, stitching together a first skeleton, then piling up three seasons of raw meat into a flesh golem. In the last winter, [PAWN_pronoun] gave both heart and soul to the phylactery. Since then no heart has beaten in the crypt; only the clatter of bones answers [PAWN_possessive] commands.
